description: Build an unsigned approval transaction. For ERC20 tokens: generates approve(spender, amount). For ERC721/ERC1155 NFTs (e.g. LP positions): generates setApprovalForAll(operator, true). Required before write.account.deposit or write.account.add_liquidity (when depositing from wallet). Tip: call read.wallet.allowances first to check if approval already exists — skip this if the current allowance is sufficient.

amount.description: ERC20 only: amount in raw units, or 'max_uint256' for unlimited. Ignored for NFTs.

asset_type.description: Token type: 'erc20' (default) for fungible tokens, 'erc721' or 'erc1155' for NFTs (LP positions)

spender_address.description: Address being approved — use the Arcadia account address for deposits

name: write.wallet.approve
